name: Kakutou Hime Leia ~Chijoku no Arena~
original_name: 格闘姫レイア ～恥辱のアリーナ～
source:
The beautiful grappling princess Leia is holding a magnificent grappling tournament.
When she's mercilessly violated by a group of monsters, her pride and sense of reason are destroyed and her shameful shrieks resound through the arena...

Smeared with disgrace, and even so continuing to fight, is there any way Leia can prevail now?!

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE041549.html]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
美丽的格斗公主莱娅正在举办一场盛大的格斗锦标赛。
当她被一群怪物无情侵犯时，她的自尊和理智被摧毁，羞耻的尖叫声响彻竞技场……

带着耻辱，还继续战斗，现在的莱娅还有什么办法能够获胜吗？！
